name: Starboard
tagline: A permanent terminal docked beside the macOS Dock
description: Starboard is a Swift app that keeps a permanent terminal pinned beside the macOS Dock — unlike Quake-style dropdown terminals that overlay and hide. It stays visible across all Spaces, behaving more like a docked workspace than a transient overlay. For developers who want a terminal always within reach without toggling, Starboard treats the terminal as a persistent, always-on surface. It is written in Swift and designed specifically for macOS.
highlights: Permanent terminal pinned beside the macOS Dock
Not an overlay — stays visible across all Spaces
Treats the terminal as a persistent, always-on surface
Written in Swift for native macOS feel
curatorNote: Most dockside terminals are transient overlays. Starboard flips that by making the terminal a permanent, always-visible docked surface — a small but meaningful rethink of how terminals live on macOS.
